notes.title: SUMMER SALE KICK-OFF: The Rebirth Update is LIVE with 50% OFF!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509825/390814e5881c99a7ea96a65f49f54268be998f69.png"]

Fellow Players,

Welcome to the Summer Season!

Today marks a new beginning for Ink: Tournament Paintball. We are kicking off a massive content expansion that we'll be rolling out in four major stages over the course of this season. Each stage will bring new maps, new markers, and new reasons to hit the field.



The first of these, the Rebirth Update, is LIVE NOW!

To celebrate this new chapter and to kick off the Steam Summer Sale, the game is also 50% OFF! There has never been a better time to get your friends together and dive in.


Summer Season Starts with Paintball

NEW ARENAS
The first drop of official 2025 layouts from National League is here! Jump into three pro fields, ready for competitive action

INK Midwest Open

INK Atlantic City Open

INK Tampa Bay Open 


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509825/efcdc8cb78e8704b5d4de231f545cb5e8f2660a9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509825/6e12517cdc1fc5b168f2739e40e5d3739f4cf3b3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509825/6596f5c8ce83c13565928b292e0f534a40e01c1d.png"][/carousel]

NEW ARSENAL: PART 1
Two new marker families have arrived. Unlock and master the FLY DRS+ and the EARTH TEK 70R and their variants in-game now! Remember, our in-game store has zero microtransactions and no pay-to-win. All content is unlocked by playing the game.


FLY DRS+[table equalcells="1" colwidth="580,"][tr][th colwidth="580"]
A new marker has landed. The FLY DRS+ makes its debut in-game, marking the arrival of the FLY brand to INK. Built for precision and speed, this high-performance marker is just the beginning — more FLY gear is on the way. Stay sharp. 
[/th][th]

*If you’re a veteran and have already made it past Level 6 (Promise), good news — you’ve just unlocked the FLY DRS+ | Noble Blue. Time to suit up and show what experience really looks like.


EARTH TEK07r[table equalcells="1" colwidth="581,"][tr][th colwidth="581"]
Meet the latest from EARTH – the TEK07r. Designed for control and consistency under pressure, this marker delivers reliable performance straight out of the box. This marker brings top-tier performance to every match.
[/th][th]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509825/6c443543be48d49d6ea244538cdb58c2fbc53f76.png"]

*If you're a beginner, you should know that you've just unlocked the Earth TEK07r | Neon.


PERFORMANCE AND FIXES

VISUAL & PERFORMANCE OVERHAUL This update includes a massive overhaul of the game's visuals and performance. From dynamic bunker physics and upgraded atmospheric rendering to huge optimizations that reduce disk size and improve frame rates, the game looks and feels better than ever. The full list of these global changes is in the changelog below.




FULL CHANGELOG


Adds

Maps: Added National League 2025 layouts: Tampa Bay Open, Atlantic City Open, Midwest Open.

Markers: Added FLY DRS+ (and 4 variants), Added EARTH TEK 70R (and 3 variants).

Visuals

Bunkers now have a subtle sway & bounce effect when shot.

Upgraded Sky & Atmosphere rendering.

Upgraded volumetric effects.

Updated/added Terrain Details/Vegetation shading & density.

Added distant vistas billboard rendering to add details to horizons.

Updated playing field net models.

Increased Bunker Sizes for improved gameplay.

Some older maps received minor visual changes like more details, props and lighting.

Improved Exposure Compensation to better fit day/night scenarios.

Increased baseline shadow resolution by 2x.

Optimizations

Distant trees have been replaced with billboards where applicable.

Some weapon models were optimized (Reduced poly count and batches by up to 70%).

Banner and other looping shaders were modified to be more reusable (less draw calls).

Improved VRAM usage by reducing some cache sizes for unused effects.

Introduced Instanced Rendering for Vegetation.

Disabled Terrain shadowcasting, improving CPU/GPU times.

Migrated old maps to APV GI instead of Lightmaps, improving memory efficiency.

Rebaked GI (average size reduced from 200mb to 20mb per map).

Static objects now use shadow caching.

Reduced terrain detail density to reduce grass overdraw on specific maps.

Removed shadowcasting from small vegetation/details.

Backend: Changed rendering to GPU Resident Drawer + GPU Occlusion Culling.

Reduced shadow cascades to 2 and reduced their draw distance.

Disabled Shadows for smaller lights, replacing them with cookies to fake shadows.

Removed SSR from 'Force' map, now uses baked Reflection Probes.

Bugfixes

Fixed audio null issue in the main-menu preventing some SFX/Ambiance from playing.

Fixed an empty weapon slot issue when selecting weapons for the workbench.

Fixed Z-fighting on 'Force' and other maps.

Fixed shadow artifacts on 'Snake Valley'.

Fixed various errors in the Class Customization UI.

Fixed Killcam not resetting/tracking properly.

Fixed AI being unable to move properly on some older maps.

Fixed weapon positions in the workbench.

notes.title: 🔧 Patch Update: Server Upgrade & New Domain!
notes.content:
We’re improving our infrastructure for a better experience! 🚀

📢 Big news! We’ve updated our servers to ensure a smoother, more stable experience for everyone. Along with this, we’re making an important change:

🔄 Our domain has changed! We are no longer goldendog.dev—from now on, we are https://goldendoginteractive.com

Our website is still under construction, but stay tuned for updates! 👷‍♂️

And remember, the biggest update in Ink: Tournament Paintball’s history is just around the corner! Stay tuned! 👀

Golden Dog Interactive, SAS.

notes.title: This Update Will Change Everything!
notes.content:
🌟 Attention, Ink: Tournament Paintball players! 🌟

Big news is coming! 🎉 We’re working on a new update that will mark a turning point for the game. 👀

👉 What’s new?
We’ve upgraded to Unity 6, and while we were already using HDRP, we’ve now fine-tuned its settings, resulting in massive improvements to performance and visual quality. ⚡🎮 This means that even players with minimum requirements will enjoy a much smoother and more stunning experience.

We know the community has been quiet lately, but now is the perfect time to get back in the game. This is only the beginning! New maps, weapons, and more are coming throughout the year, but let’s take it one step at a time. 🚀

💬 We want to hear from you:
What are you hoping to see in this new chapter of the game? Got ideas or suggestions? Let us know in the comments! 🖊️

🔥 Get hyped with us for this new era of Ink: Tournament Paintball. The comeback is closer than you think!

notes.title: A Fresh New Look
notes.content:
What’s Changed?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509825/d238a90f7d1218e0f7cc6f17a219cb7f6e5d1654.gif

ADDED

 Rebounding Paintballs: Some paintballs can now bounce off soft surfaces (like bunkers).
 New BOTGAME Servers: Two new servers for easy access to the battlefield.
 Speedball Focus: The default weapon is now the Kingdom Mini GT instead of the Tripplordd 85 Rental.
 Unlocked Store: The store is now accessible from level 0 (Beginner).
 Increased In-Game Earnings: Hit and headshot rewards have been increased by 500%, making it easier to earn in-game money (D$).
 Enhanced BOT Behavior: Bots in BOTGAME now feel more realistic, with improved AI that can take cover and shoot from bunkers.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509825/4e0086121d21295b1dcfcdba6159182f3bacecfd.png

REMOVED

 Microtransactions: DawgCards are no longer available.
 Competitive Mode: Due to the low player base and the need for at least 3v3 real humans, we have disabled this feature. We may consider reactivating it if the community shows interest.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509825/4974471a9be4c457f098fe004a99adbf51843557.png

FIXED / IMPROVED

 Simplified Menu: Everything is now just one click away.
 Marker Handling: Adjusted marker handling for better gameplay.
 Improved Text Contrast: Enhanced contrast for better readability.
 Reduced Price: The game price has been reduced by 50% from USD 9.99 to USD 4.99.


We are eager to add the remaining field layouts for the 2022 and 2023 seasons and bring you all the new content for 2024. Feel free to leave your comments here or in our #suggestions channel on Discord.

As we celebrate the spirit of freedom and unity this 4th of July, we at Golden Dog Interactive, SAS, want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to our incredible community. Your passion and feedback continue to drive us forward. Enjoy the fireworks, the festivities, and some exhilarating games of Ink: Tournament Paintball!

Happy Independence Day!

Golden Dog Interactive, SAS

notes.title: Welcome to 2024 🔫
notes.content:
BRIEF:

This update brings several fixes to the experience. Server lists now accurately display and update with all ongoing matches in your services area. Workbench guns have been fixed to ensure they no longer interfere with the user interface. A rework of the Competitive Team Menu is in progress, and there's an ongoing post-production rework of the main menu. Additionally, various minor UI adjustments have been made for a smoother user interface. 

Christmas Content is not longer available in the Store. Furthermore, we are currently working on a new and free Expansion of Content that we will reveal soon.

BUG FIXES:


Server lists now properly display and update with all the current matches in your services area.
The level number on the top profile and in the Missions Menu now counts "Beginner" as level "0." You may notice yourself at a lower level number.
Workbench guns no longer overlap with the UI.
Competitive Team Menu rework (work in progress).
Main menu post-production rework.
Other small UI adjustments.


Golden Dog Interactive, SAS.

Stay tuned this Friday to be a part of the start of competitive mode with 5V5 rankings.

Hello @everyone,

0.02.014 is out now, with a huge Menu UI change.
 
I've been watching and analyzing other fps games and noticed that there was a gap between the difficulty of navigation in Tint 'n Ink and the ease of others.
So I got to work, but of course the current version is just a first week implemention, but If you like it I could improve it a lot! 

Spin wheel is deactived for now. 
Loadout and Lockers (player outfit) are changeables from the same window.
Workbench is so much easier to navigate. 

Please check the poll on our Discord to vote if you like or not after try it!

notes.title: Unexpected and Forced Update!
notes.content:
For the first time we have experienced technical difficulties with the servers, apparently our network service provider has reconfigured some parameters and with it the previously used protocol has suffered bugs. 🚀 

After discovering this, we are updating Tint 'n Ink as soon as possible, which led to this unexpected update.

It is very likely that you will find new bugs that we will solve in the next update, but we had a forced update to be online again. 👨‍✈️

Thanks for playing!
Golden Dog Interactive, Inc.
